description: This PHP source file defines the LocationDao class, which serves as a Data Access Object for managing location entities within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It provides methods for retrieving, searching, saving, and deleting location records from the database, as well as methods for related data such as employee counts and location IDs.

classes.name: LocationDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class that provides methods for interacting with location data stored in the database, including retrieval, search, save, and delete operations.

methods.name: getLocationById
methods.description: Retrieves a Location entity by its ID. Returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingLocationIds
methods.description: Returns an array of existing location IDs from a list of given IDs.

methods.name: getSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of locations matching the provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: searchLocations
methods.description: Searches for locations matching the provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: searchLocationsPaginator
methods.description: Sets up and returns a paginator to retrieve a paginated list of locations based on search filters.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Returns the number of employees associated with a specific location ID.

methods.name: getLocationsIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all location IDs ordered by name.

methods.name: getLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Returns location IDs associated with the given employee numbers.

methods.name: getLocationsByIds
methods.description: Retrieves Location entities for the specified list of IDs.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Persists a Location entity into the database.

methods.name: deleteLocations
methods.description: Deletes Location records with specified IDs.
